study: Calendar-flow family on SPY and IWM: do the turn-of-month, quarter-end, pre-holiday, tax-loss-January and options-expiration windows earn more than other days, after costs?
registered_at: 2026-10-16 ~06:00 ET, before any data for these windows was computed.
origin: Operator 10/16; the family of the one effect that passed here (month-end SPY, +20.6 bp, t 3.7, 289 months; docs/studies/MONTH_END_REBAL_2026-10-01.md).
prior: MEDIUM for turn-of-month and pre-holiday (widely published, may be weaker since publication), LOW for options expiration, LOW-MEDIUM for tax-loss January in small caps (IWM).
data: Yahoo adjusted daily closes (yfinance, as month_end_rebal.py) for SPY 1993-02 and IWM 2000-06 to 2026-10-15; close-to-close returns; NYSE trading calendar from the data itself.

windows.TOM: turn of month: last trading day of the month through the 3rd trading day of the next (4 days)
windows.QE: quarter-end: last 2 trading days of Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec
windows.PREHOL: the trading day before a market holiday (a weekday the market is closed)
windows.TAXJAN: IWM only: last 3 trading days of December through the 5th trading day of January
windows.OPEX: options-expiration week: Monday through the third Friday of the month

statistic: per window: mean daily return in-window minus mean daily return out-of-window (all other days), with a t from a two-sample test on daily returns and a year-clustered check; also the strategy return of holding the ETF only in-window, net of 2 bp per round trip (ETF spread at the close).
multiplicity: 9 window x ETF cells (5 windows on SPY, 4 on IWM incl. TAXJAN; TAXJAN not on SPY): pass t >= 2.6 (Bonferroni-ish for 9 cells at one-sided 0.05 ~ 2.5-2.6).
pass: a cell PASSES only if in BOTH halves: in-minus-out > 0 with t >= 2.6 AND the in-window strategy is positive after cost. Month-end alone (already passed) is reported, not re-graded.
information_only: combined calendar book (SPY in any passing window) - cumulative return, max drawdown, days invested
no_retuning: window definitions above are fixed; other lengths are a new prereg.
if_pass: add passing windows to the month-end pilot as score-only, then paper forward for >= 6 months of windows before any money.
if_fail: calendar effects beyond month-end are closed for this desk.

amended_1.at: 2026-10-16, after result-skeptic round 1 (NOT READY, findings 9-15), before any score was computed by this script.
amended_1.prior_disclosure: NOT fully unseen (#9): Round 5 T3 (STRATEGY_EDGE_ROUND5_2026-09-26.md:203-229) scored SPY TOM and pre-holiday 2021-2026 (TOM excess -23/-20/+69 bp, PREHOL t <= 1.5); MONTH_END_REBAL_2026-10-01.md reported first-3-sessions and quarter-end weakness. The 2010+ half of SPY TOM/PREHOL/QE is partly seen; the <2010 half and IWM are the cleaner test. Month-end itself is a SIGNED SPY-TLT rule, unproven until forward months score, not a long-only pass.

windows.TOM: first 3 trading days of the month; the month's last trading day is EXCLUDED (that is the month-end lead)
windows.QE: the second-to-last trading day of Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec only (the last day is month-end, excluded)
windows.PREHOL: the last trading day before a SCHEDULED NYSE full-day holiday, from a rule list (New Year, MLK from 1998, Presidents, Good Friday, Memorial, Juneteenth from 2022, July 4, Labor, Thanksgiving, Christmas; Saturday New Year not observed). Unscheduled closures (9/11/2001, Sandy 2012, state funerals) and missing data rows are NOT holidays (#11).

amended_1.out_of_window: days in NO window and not a month's last trading day (#10); windows may overlap each other but each is compared with the same clean NONE set.
amended_1.statistic: one difference per calendar YEAR: mean in-window daily return minus mean NONE daily return that year; the pass t is the t of those yearly differences (#12). Pooled Welch t is dropped.
amended_1.underpowered: a half with fewer than 8 years or fewer than 30 in-window days is UNDERPOWERED, not FAIL (#12).
amended_1.pass: a cell PASSES only if, in BOTH halves (split 2010-01-01), the yearly-difference mean > 0 with t >= 2.6. The in-window strategy after 2 bp is information only (#13). Otherwise FAIL (or UNDERPOWERED).
amended_1.data_pin: yfinance auto_adjust=True adjusted closes, as month_end_rebal.py:142 (#14); early-close half days kept.
amended_1.script: tools/studies/calendar_flows.py; window logic tested in tests/test_calendar_flows.py.
amended_1.verdict_rule: FAIL if any powered half misses t >= 2.6; UNDERPOWERED only if no powered half fails and fewer than 2 halves are powered; PASS needs both halves powered and passing. Strategy line, combined book and by-decade table are not computed (information only, omitted). Skeptic round 2: READY 2026-10-16.
